rule_text: All students reported in File (E) must have a corresponding enrollment record reported for them in School Student File (C) at the same school.
All courses reported in File (E) must have a corresponding course record reported for them for the same school in Course Catalog File (D).
source: File E description; E06 business rules

rule_text: All staff reported in File (G) must have a corresponding staff record reported for them in Staff File (F).
source: File G description; G04 business rules

rule_text: All courses reported in File (G) must have a corresponding course record reported for them for the same school in Course Catalog File (D).
source: File G description; G05 business rules

rule_text: All students reported in File (I) must have an enrollment record reported for them in School Student File (C).
notes: The text does not say 'same school'.

rule_text: All students reported in File (K) must be reported as having a disability in Student Attributes and Programs File (I).
If the student is reported in Special Education File (K) they must be reported with a valid value equal to 36 – Student Identified With a Disability in Element I06.
Students reported in this file must also be reported in District Student File (B), School Student File (C), and Student Attributes and Programs File (I).
This date must be equal to the date contained in Element I07 – Start Date.
notes: Q06 program code and Q07 start date identify the matching File I program record.

condition: I06 in (6,7,37,38,44); at end of school year
rule_text: Districts must submit LAP File Q data for students submitted in Element I06 – Attribute or Program Code with any of the valid values of 6, 7, 37, 38, or 44 by the end of the current school year.
notes: Reverse direction: an I program record requires a Q record by year end.

rule_text: Students reported in this file must also be reported in District Student File (B) and School Student File (C).
If Element R15 is Y – Yes, the student must be reported as receiving special education services in the Student Special Education Programs File (K).

match_scope: same district, same school, S07 within enrollment
rule_text: The Location ID reported should be the enrolled Location ID of the student at the time of the reported action.
notes: CLAUDE.md lists 'S requires B and C'. The v19 manual has no such statement for File S; this is the closest rule. See decisions log.

rule_text: Students reported in this file must also be reported in District Student File (B) and School Student File (C).
Non-scheduled courses are courses for students where there is not a corresponding record in the Course Catalog File (D) or the Student Schedule File (E).
notes: Negative rule: T holds attempts that are NOT in D/E.

rule_text: The Location ID submitted in Element E05 and Element D03 – Location ID, for the same course, must map to the same School Code submitted in Location File (A), Element A05 – School Code.

The Location ID submitted in Element G03 and Element D03 – Location ID, for the corresponding record in both files, must map to the same School Code submitted in Location File (A), Element A05 – School Code.
This date must be the same as, or earlier than, the date contained in Element C06 – Date Student Enrolled in School.
If a date is entered, then Element C08 – Date Student Exited from School should have a matching exit date for the school within the district that was last attended by the student.
If the student is also leaving the district Element B15 – Date Exited from District must also be provided.
The enrollment date must be on or after Element B09 – Birth Date.
This date must be equal to or greater than the date contained in Element B14 – Date Enrolled in District.

rule_text: The program start date must be on or after Element B09 – Birth Date.

condition: J07 >= A07 and J07 >= B14 and J07 >= J22
rule_text: If the student qualifies for services, the Program Status Start Date must be on or after Element A07 – Initial School Start Date, on or after Element B14 – Date Enrolled in District and on or after Element J22 – Placement Test Date.
The date reported must be equal to or greater than the date reported in Element A07 – Initial School Start Date.

match_scope: same district, same school, same course and section
rule_text: This value will be used to connect teacher and student schedules so the designator for Term must be the same for Element E08 and Element G07 – Term.
notes: Basis for dim_section = union of E and G keys.

rule_text: If Element E09 contains a valid value of O – Online then Element D07 – Course Designation Code must contain a valid value of O – Online.

condition: D07 contains O => E10, E11 required
rule_text: If Element D07 – Course Designation Code contains a valid value of O – Online then Element E10 – Approved Online Provider is required.
source: E10 business rules (E11 has the same rule)

rule_text: If the course is not a transfer credit, and Element A05 – School Code matches Element H26 – School Code, then the same CIP Code Number must also be reported in Element D10 – CIP Code.
If Element A05 – School Code matches Element H26 – School Code (indicating this is not a transfer credit) then term must be supplied.
notes: H19 is part of the design's File H grain but is NULL for transfer credits.

rule_text: If Element J17 contains valid value = 1 and Element J09 does not contain a valid value of P, one of the elements, Element B17 – Primary Language Code or Element B18 – Student Language Spoken at Home, must have a language code other than 639 – English.
If Element J17 contains valid value = 3, Element B17 – Primary Language Code and Element B18 – Student Language Spoken at Home, must be 639 – English or 640 – American Sign Language.
Element C09 – School Withdrawal Code must indicate withdrawal from district.
If Element B13 – Grade Level is not PK, you must report NULL.
LRE codes reported must be appropriate to the current age and Grade Level (Element B13) of the student.
Valid value 11 - LAP Extended Learning Opportunities Program eligibility is limited to students in grades 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 as reported in Element B13 – Grade Level.
May only be 1 – Dyslexia if Element B13 – Grade Level is K1, K2, 1, or 2.

match_scope: same district, same school, same student
rule_text: Entry and exit dates may not overlap for individual students.
If Ethnicity Code equals '10' (Non– Hispanic), there cannot be other records in this file for the same student.

match_scope: same district, same student, same incident (R06)
rule_text: Each exclusionary action associated with a student for a single incident must be reported with identical incident information in Elements R01 through R10.
notes: Basis for the incident degenerate dimension in fact_exclusionary_action.

rule_text: Element E06 – Course ID, Element E07 – Section ID and Element E08 - Term combination must be distinct.

notes: Basis for the dim_school 9999 special member.
